newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end up on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end up on selective buying.

text.p: * Market still seen trading in narrow range
Selective buying nudged up the Manila stock market in lacklustre trading on Friday, traders said.
The main index added 5.19 points to 3,242.22 after Thursday's 11.56-point decline.
"We are still in the same situation - trading in a narrow range," said Antonio Escano, senior vice president of Pryce Securities.
Brokers said the market continued to be locked in a tight band due to worries on U.S. interest rates. The U.S. Fed is slated to meet on September 24.
Jonathan Go of Guoco Securities said "the market's very flat. The storm still has to pass through this period of uncertainty."
Traders said the market was marked by speculative buying on second-liner issues such as Belle Corp, APC Group Inc and MRC Allied Industries Inc.
Key index stock Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co lost 15 pesos to 1,685 pesos following its $1.75-drop in New York.
